payload.title: Step 3: REVIEWS corpus in unified_corpus.py and reviews loader in rubric_screen.py
payload.description:
## Purpose

Step 3: `REVIEWS` corpus in `unified_corpus.py` and a reviews loader in `scripts/rubric_screen.py`.

## Scope

- Labels (precedence order abusive > promotional > seller_shipping > price_availability > approve; merge abusive into "remove_other" if < 20 pool cases), S one-liner, F path (under `var/`), ceiling, `final_size=300`, multiclass metrics.
- Splits: SME labels 1,500; stream 600 + held-out 300 drawn stratified by SME label (each minority class >= ~10%); natural-mix random 300 reported too. Disjoint partitions; nothing tuned on held-out.
- Reviews loader in `scripts/rubric_screen.py` for the Stage 0 S-vs-F screen.

## Definition of done

Specs pass offline with fixtures; `make test` and `make unified-flywheel-test` green; existing corpora replays byte-identical.

## Caps

$0 (offline).
